Engagement Ring Shopper Leads

CaratBase sends engagement ring shopper leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers and appraisers. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

  • First 3 leads free
  • $40 per accepted lead
  • Optional Pro website widget, $12/month

Why CaratBase

Independent jewelers can focus on sales while CaratBase sends local engagement ring shoppers their way, starting in Atlanta.

FAQ

Is there a minimum commitment? No. You pay only for the leads you accept; the first 3 are free.

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
